# ERDI TECH open tools for laser rangefinder and LiDAR modules

> Free, MIT-licensed tools and data for engineers integrating laser rangefinders and single-point LiDAR modules into drones, robots and instruments. Maintained by ERDI TECH LTD (https://erdilrf.com/), a maker of 905 nm and 1535 nm laser rangefinder modules. The tools work with modules from many vendors.

## Tools

- [LiDAR / laser rangefinder UART decoder](https://erditech.github.io/lrf-uart-protocol-decoder/): paste a hex dump or connect over WebSerial; detects protocol and baud rate, decodes frames to metres, flags checksum errors. Profiles for Benewake (TFmini, TFmini-S, TFmini Plus, TF-Luna, TF02-Pro, TF03), LightWare (SF30/D binary, SF10/SF11 ASCII), Chengdu JRT, Nooploop TOFSense, DFRobot SEN0366 and ERDI. Python: `pip install lrf-uart-decoder`. Source: https://github.com/ErdiTech/lrf-uart-protocol-decoder
- [Protocol reference for the decoder](https://github.com/ErdiTech/lrf-uart-protocol-decoder/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOLS.md): frame tables, checksum rules and invalid-reading codes with links to each vendor manual.

## Data

- [Laser rangefinder and LiDAR module database](https://erditech.github.io/laser-rangefinder-module-database/): comparison of modules by range, wavelength, accuracy, update rate, interface, weight, size and public price, with a manufacturer source URL and capture date per row. CSV and JSON in https://github.com/ErdiTech/laser-rangefinder-module-database (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24125641).

## Drivers

- [erdi-lrf (Python, PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/erdi-lrf/): drivers and CLI for ERDI modules; source https://github.com/ErdiTech/erdi-lrf-drivers
- [ErdiLRF (Arduino / PlatformIO)](https://github.com/ErdiTech/ErdiLRF)
- [erdi_lrf_driver (ROS 2, sensor_msgs/Range)](https://github.com/ErdiTech/erdi_lrf_driver)
- [ArduPilot serial driver pull request](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/34983): RNGFNDx_TYPE 49 (ERDI VB series) and 50 (ERDI H series)

- [ERDI models, datasheets and public prices](https://erdilrf.com/models/)
